test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 1 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Complete the collocation.**

Since I like him a lot, I _____ him out.
solution:
The correct answer is **option 3 i.e. asked.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• We use **since** with a point in time in the past. 
 
• The meaning of '**ask out' **is **invite someone out on a date.**
 
• From the word **like **in the first part of the sentence, it is clear that **asked** is the correct option.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is Option 3.

**Correct Sentence:**__ *Since I like him a lot, I **__asked__ **him out.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Talk** **out** means discuss something thoroughly in order to solve a problem or reach a conclusion.
 
• **Go out **means to leave the place where you live or work for a short time, returning on the same day.
 
• **Call out **means summon someone to deal with an emergency or provide a service.
 
• What is a **collocation**?
 
 
• A **collocation **is two or more words that often go together. These combinations just sound "right" to native English speakers, who use them all the time.
 
• **Examples**: a quick shower, a quick meal, a hard frost etc.
